verdict.rationale: The evidence documents subscriber lookup and search, filtering by last-event dates, write-only event tracking (POST /batch/events), and broadcast-level history. None of it shows an API endpoint that returns a single contact's history of emails sent, opened, or clicked. Looking up a subscriber record or reviewing broadcast history is adjacent, not per-person engagement history.

support.subject: As a developer, I can read per-person engagement history — what was sent, opened, clicked — through the API for any contact
